reuse.why: Hooks into the existing pre-link guard that every provider's link function already calls, so no provider needs its own check.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once and nothing is copied.

placement.why: Right layer and shared choke point, but the closed-account rule is folded into a function named assertNotLinkedElsewhere, whose name and purpose (single-link rule) no longer describe what it checks.

maintainability.why: Small and centralised; a reader looking for the closed-account rule would not expect it inside assertNotLinkedElsewhere, so a rename or a sibling assert would read better.

one_place.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by every link*Account function before linking.
